subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below show the runs scored by 5 batsmen in a cricket match. Total runs scored by these five batsmen are 700. Runs scored by a batsman is shown as a percentage of mas scored by all these five batsmen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94dcebd02ae9f11676e4219f2ac247e6351604544b4fa01924a585b213a4bc73.png] 

What are total runs scored by L, N and R?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total runs = 700

Run scored by L, N and R = 29% + 12% + 13% = 54%

Total runs scored by L, N and R = 54/100 × 700 = 378

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
